method: Complete named explanatory fields from the exact subject/pointer. Original summaries, subjects and historical reviews unchanged. This is an excerpt, not a standalone replacement contract or review.

summary.answer: Builds the WZ back HUD children including team/player/ammo/inventory/compass/collapse/reinsertion/death notifications. Spawn selection hides deployable notifications; dead+not hacked+not spawn-select gates DeathCamContainer. KilledBy is locally always hidden; killer identity is hidden outside killcam, binds Attacker and updates emblem/name/rank views only for nonnil data. Overall caster-profile/spawn-select hides are separate predicates. The constructor wires child source contracts; it does not reconstruct every child, event producer or server state.
unknowns: Exact source-to-original-PS4/build match and decompiler fidelity unverified.
Native LUI/Engine/VM/model ownership, callback delivery/order, cancellation, assets/localization/settings/DDL/storage/network/services and unavailable server code remain unverified where used.
Source-ready close body exists outside frozen allowed companion range; exact locator is retained in new_dependencies. Other class clip bodies not frozen were not authored.

Additional same-class reset/clip/close body ranges are available but outside the frozen author scope; exact locators are in unfrozen_same_class_body_locators and source-frontier.json. No body authoring or completion credit for them.

summary.answer: Builds style and damage-contribution obituary children and forwards the parent model to both. State depends on style==0, style==4, and PC; style changes trigger validation. The exact state predicates do not establish effective squad-wipe settings.
unknowns: Original PS4/source exact-version and original Lua/VM binding remain unverified.
Effective enum/mode/platform/settings and asset/model/storage data are unavailable.
Native/LUI event/subscription/timer dispatch, cleanup guarantees and errors not shown in selected source remain open.
Unavailable service/server code is not reconstructed or counted.

summary.answer: Builds player-name, expanded-callout and squad-killed children and binds each to the parent model. HiddenPreference checks kill-identity hiding; Visible uses the full recorded demo/caster/HUD/death/killcam/UI/training gate. Settings and visibility subscriptions only validate state. Existing close and optional PostLoadFunc precede InitObituaryCallout and return self. Kill-event generation and callback delivery remain separate gaps.
unknowns: No actual callback delivery, cancellation-after-close, successful native mutation or service response is proved.
Recovered source defects, nil fallthroughs, repeated/replaced registrations and opaque aliases are preserved rather than repaired.
